svg.title: Command pattern: the undo and redo stacks after each editor action
svg.desc: Seven actions: append Hello, append space world, delete last 6, undo, undo, redo, append exclamation mark. The document reads Hello, Hello world, Hello, Hello world, Hello, Hello world, Hello world!. Each command moves between the undo stack and the redo stack; the new edit at the end clears the redo stack.
svg.text: each edit is an object that knows how to undo itself
the command that moved in this step
